zoning_districts.name: Comercial Turístico
zoning_districts.citation_section: Regla 6.1.12 (pp. 404–409); equivalencias San Juan: Sección 6.1.1.4, Tabla 6.14
zoning_districts.equivalence_note: RC 2023 Tabla 6.14 maps San Juan POT CT-1/CT-2/CT-3 to C-T. A parcel mapped as 'CT' is read as C-T; confirm the municipal map conversion.

zoning_districts.name: Rural General
zoning_districts.unlisted_citation: Tabla 6.69: «Otros usos vía consulta de ubicación»

zoning_districts.name: Área de Bosque
zoning_districts.unlisted_citation: Tabla 6.78: «Otros usos mediante consulta de ubicación ante la Junta Adjudicativa»

zoning_districts.name: Residencial Comercial
zoning_districts.purpose: Combines residential and commercial uses; the principal use is residential, and part or all of the first floor may be commercial or service (Sección 6.1.5.2(a), p. 373).

zoning_districts.name: Dotacional General
zoning_districts.citation_section: Tabla 6.6 (p. 322) equivalence; district rules not yet encoded
zoning_districts.purpose: Public / institutional facilities (dotacional). SmartPR has not encoded this district's use table.

use_permissions.name: Hotel in C-T
conditions: Lodging uses are allowed above the second level (Sección 6.1.12.2(c)); the first two levels are for commercial/service uses (6.1.12.2(b)).
Apartment and lodging projects follow Sección 6.1.1.6 (density).
Hotel common areas do not count toward gross floor area (Tabla 6.58).

use_permissions.name: Multifamily in C-T
conditions: Residential uses are allowed above the second level (Sección 6.1.12.2(c)).
Density: one basic dwelling unit per 100 m² of lot (C-T Liviano) or per 70 m² (C-T Intermedio) — Tabla 6.58.
Residential uses need street access and parking independent of the commercial uses (Tabla 6.58).
use_permissions.citation_section: Sección 6.1.12.2(c); Tabla 6.57 (Residencial: Casa de apartamento); Tabla 6.58 (Densidad)

use_permissions.name: Restaurant in C-T
conditions: Commercial and service uses are allowed in the first two levels (Sección 6.1.12.2(b)).

use_permissions.name: Retail in C-T
conditions: Commercial and service uses are allowed in the first two levels (Sección 6.1.12.2(b)).

use_permissions.name: Office in C-T
conditions: Commercial and service uses are allowed in the first two levels (Sección 6.1.12.2(b)).

use_permissions.name: Daycare in C-T
conditions: Commercial and service uses are allowed in the first two levels (Sección 6.1.12.2(b)).

use_permissions.name: Nightclub in C-T
conditions: Allowed only by exception (uso vía excepción); a public hearing is required before authorization.

use_permissions.name: Warehouse in C-T
conditions: Warehouse/storage is not listed among the uses permitted in C-T (Tabla 6.57) nor among the uses by exception (Sección 6.1.12.3).
use_permissions.notes: Not listed ≠ automatically prohibited in every case: a consulta de ubicación or variance may be the only path, and approval is not assured.

use_permissions.name: Solar Utility in C-T
conditions: A utility-scale solar plant as the principal use is not listed in C-T (Tabla 6.57) nor by exception (Sección 6.1.12.3).
Rooftop or accessory solar serving a permitted use is a different question and is not evaluated here.

use_permissions.name: Single Family in R-G
conditions: Density per consulta de ubicación (Tabla 6.70).
use_permissions.citation_section: Tabla 6.69 (Sección 6.1.17.2): Vivienda para una (1) o dos (2) familias

use_permissions.name: Agrotourism in R-G
use_permissions.citation_section: Tabla 6.69 (Sección 6.1.17.2): Agro-hospedería; Eco-hospedería; Actividades ecoturísticas y agroturísticas

use_permissions.name: Retail in R-G
conditions: Retail of basic-necessity goods up to 10,000 sq ft of gross floor area; larger only for animals and agricultural products (Tabla 6.69).
use_permissions.citation_section: Tabla 6.69 (Sección 6.1.17.2): Venta al detal de productos de primera necesidad

use_permissions.name: Solar Utility in R-G
conditions: Subject to the design parameters of Tabla 6.70 and the other provisions of Regla 6.1.17.

use_permissions.name: Short Term Rental in R-G
use_permissions.citation_section: Tabla 6.69 (Sección 6.1.17.2): Alojamiento Suplementario a Corto Plazo

use_permissions.name: Restaurant in R-G
conditions: Only a small cafetín is listed; a full restaurant goes through consulta de ubicación («Otros usos vía consulta de ubicación»).

use_permissions.name: Agrotourism in A-B
conditions: A-B is a conservation district: uses must be compatible with forest protection (Sección 6.1.22.1).
use_permissions.citation_section: Tabla 6.78 (Sección 6.1.22.2): Instalación para actividades agro-turística y eco-turística; Ecohospedería

use_permissions.name: Bnb in A-B
conditions: A-B is a conservation district (Sección 6.1.22.1).

use_permissions.name: Single Family in A-B
conditions: One- or two-family dwelling per farm (finca).
use_permissions.citation_section: Tabla 6.78: Vivienda de una (1) o dos (2) familias por finca

use_permissions.name: Agriculture in A-B
conditions: Mainly agroforestry and silviculture; other crops and compatible livestock as recommended by the Departamento de Agricultura.
use_permissions.citation_section: Tabla 6.78: Agrícolas, principalmente agro-forestería y silvicultura

use_permissions.name: Retail in A-B
conditions: Only products harvested on the farm, in a building of no more than 75 m².
use_permissions.citation_section: Tabla 6.78: Venta de productos cosechados en la finca

use_permissions.name: Short Term Rental in R-I
use_permissions.citation_section: Tabla 6.32: Alojamiento Suplementario a Corto Plazo

use_permissions.name: Hotel in R-I
conditions: Hospedería by exception: Compañía de Turismo certification, no more than 15 lodging units, minimum lot per Tabla 6.33.
A hotel is allowed by exception only inside a historic zone (Sección 6.1.3.3(c)).

use_permissions.name: Bnb in C-T
conditions: Lodging uses are allowed above the second level (Sección 6.1.12.2(c)).

use_permissions.name: Short Term Rental in C-T
conditions: Lodging uses are allowed above the second level (Sección 6.1.12.2(c)).
use_permissions.citation_section: Tabla 6.57 (Hospederías: Alojamiento suplementario a corto plazo)

use_permissions.name: Single-family dwelling in R-C
conditions: The principal use in R-C is residential (Sección 6.1.5.2(a), p. 373).
New construction must meet Tabla 6.41 design parameters and Sección 6.1.1.11 (Sección 6.1.5.5, p. 375).

development_standards.name: Minimum lot size
development_standards.value: 450 m² (C-T Liviano) · 1,000 m² (C-T Intermedio)

development_standards.name: Minimum lot width
development_standards.value: 15 m (Liviano) · 20 m (Intermedio)

development_standards.name: Maximum lot occupancy
development_standards.value: 75% (Liviano) · 75% interior / 85% corner lots (Intermedio)

development_standards.name: Maximum gross floor area
development_standards.value: 300% interior / 340% corner (Liviano) · 500% interior / 560% corner (Intermedio); hotel common areas excluded

development_standards.name: Residential density
development_standards.value: 1 dwelling unit per 100 m² of lot (Liviano) · per 70 m² (Intermedio); apartments/lodging per Sección 6.1.1.6

development_standards.name: Front yard
development_standards.value: 2–3 m paved like the sidewalk (Liviano) · 3–4 m; new construction replaces it with a 5–7 m high gallery (Intermedio)

development_standards.name: Rear yard
development_standards.value: ≥ 3 m (Liviano) · ≥ 3 m and ≥ 1/5 of building height (Intermedio)

development_standards.name: Minimum lot size
development_standards.value: 25 cuerdas

development_standards.name: Maximum lot occupancy
development_standards.value: Lots > 5 cuerdas: set by the activity · 1–5 cuerdas: 20% · < 1 cuerda: 50%

development_standards.name: Maximum gross floor area
development_standards.value: Lots > 5 cuerdas: set by the activity · 1–5 cuerdas: 40% · < 1 cuerda: 100% of the lot

development_standards.name: Setbacks
development_standards.value: ≥ 6 m from any road right-of-way; side and rear ≥ 3 m or 1/5 of building height, whichever is greater

development_standards.name: Residential density
development_standards.value: One- or two-family dwellings as set in the consulta de ubicación

development_standards.name: Minimum lot size
development_standards.value: 400 m² (high-density urban areas) · existing lot size (traditional urban centres)
development_standards.variant_note: Tabla 6.41 has two columns — 'Áreas urbanas de alta densidad' and 'Centros urbanos tradicionales'. Which column applies to a parcel is not determined by SmartPR.

development_standards.name: Minimum lot width
development_standards.value: 20 m (high-density urban areas) · existing width (traditional urban centres)
development_standards.variant_note: Tabla 6.41 has two columns — 'Áreas urbanas de alta densidad' and 'Centros urbanos tradicionales'. Which column applies to a parcel is not determined by SmartPR.

development_standards.name: Maximum lot occupancy
development_standards.value: Interior lots 70% · corner 80% · two/three corners 90% · whole block 100% (high-density urban areas); 75% · 85% · 95% · 100% (traditional urban centres)
development_standards.variant_note: Tabla 6.41 has two columns — 'Áreas urbanas de alta densidad' and 'Centros urbanos tradicionales'. Which column applies to a parcel is not determined by SmartPR.

development_standards.name: Maximum gross floor area
development_standards.value: 250% or per Sección 6.1.4.6 (high-density urban areas); 450% interior / 510% corner (traditional urban centres); no upper floor may exceed the maximum occupancy
development_standards.variant_note: Tabla 6.41 has two columns — 'Áreas urbanas de alta densidad' and 'Centros urbanos tradicionales'. Which column applies to a parcel is not determined by SmartPR.

development_standards.name: Residential density
development_standards.value: 1 basic dwelling unit per 150 m² of lot (high-density urban areas; convertible per Sección 6.1.1.5) · 1 per 80 m² (traditional urban centres)
development_standards.variant_note: Tabla 6.41 has two columns — 'Áreas urbanas de alta densidad' and 'Centros urbanos tradicionales'. Which column applies to a parcel is not determined by SmartPR.

development_standards.name: Front yard
development_standards.value: 3 m or 1/5 of building height, whichever is greater (high-density urban areas) · 1 m or 1/5 of height; exempt where neighbours have no front yard (traditional urban centres)
development_standards.variant_note: Tabla 6.41 has two columns — 'Áreas urbanas de alta densidad' and 'Centros urbanos tradicionales'. Which column applies to a parcel is not determined by SmartPR.

development_standards.name: Rear yard
development_standards.value: 4 m or 1/5 of building height, whichever is greater (high-density urban areas) · 3 m or 1/5 of height (traditional urban centres)
development_standards.variant_note: Tabla 6.41 has two columns — 'Áreas urbanas de alta densidad' and 'Centros urbanos tradicionales'. Which column applies to a parcel is not determined by SmartPR.

development_standards.name: Side yards
development_standards.value: Two side yards of at least 4 m or 1/5 of height (high-density urban areas) · 2 m or 1/5 of height where the parcel abuts another district; party-wall development allowed between same-district parcels (traditional urban centres)
development_standards.variant_note: Tabla 6.41 has two columns — 'Áreas urbanas de alta densidad' and 'Centros urbanos tradicionales'. Which column applies to a parcel is not determined by SmartPR.

site_rules.name: Construction intersecting a FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area
evidence: Elevation Certificate (FEMA Form FF-206-FY-22-152)
Flood-resistant design per Reglamento de Planificación Núm. 13
V-zone design certification by a registered engineer or architect (44 CFR 60.3(e)(4)) when the work is in a coastal high-hazard Zone V/VE

site_rules.name: Work in a regulatory floodway
evidence: No-rise (encroachment) hydraulic analysis by a licensed engineer

site_rules.name: Development inside the coastal zone
evidence: Coastal-zone consistency information for the reviewing agency
Federal consistency certification if a federal permit or funding is involved (15 CFR §930.57)
site_rules.citation_section: Programa de Manejo de la Zona Costanera; 15 CFR §930.57

site_rules.name: Karst special planning area overlay (APE-ZC)
evidence: Review against the Plan y Reglamento del Área de Planificación Especial de la Zona Cársica (Res. JP-CARSO)
site_rules.citation_section: Res. JP-CARSO (vigencia 4-jul-2014); Ley 292-1999; RC 2023 Sección 6.1.1.1(b),(e) (special plans prevail; the most protective rule applies)

site_rules.name: Work that may place fill in mapped wetlands / waters
site_rules.agency: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers / DRNA
evidence: Wetland delineation by a qualified professional
Section 404 permit or a no-permit determination (USACE)

site_rules.name: Activity inside a mapped protected natural area or reserve
evidence: Written position of the managing agency (DRNA) on the designation

site_rules.name: Earthwork in an archaeologically sensitive area
evidence: ICP archaeology endorsement / Phase IA study

site_rules.name: Work in a historic zone or on a historic site
site_rules.agency: Instituto de Cultura Puertorriqueña / Junta de Planificación
evidence: Historic-zone review / ICP endorsement before exterior or structural work
site_rules.citation_section: Historic-zone review requirements — section to confirm

site_rules.name: Proposed use not listed for the zoning district
evidence: Consulta de ubicación (or variance where the Reglamento Conjunto allows one) — approval not assured
site_rules.citation_section: RC 2023, Capítulo de Consultas de Ubicación y Variaciones; Ley 161-2009 Art. 2.5

site_rules.name: Use allowed only by exception
evidence: Exception request with public hearing (vista pública)

site_rules.name: Generation project interconnection
evidence: Interconnection application and technical studies

site_rules.name: Lodging operation registration
evidence: PRTC innkeeper/hotelier registration
site_rules.citation_section: Citation carried by the linked permit document

site_rules.name: Food service health permit
evidence: Sanitary/health license for food service
site_rules.citation_section: Citation carried by the linked permit document

site_rules.name: Construction permit
site_rules.agency: OGPe, or the autonomous municipality's permits office where permit powers were transferred
site_rules.citation_section: Regla 3.2.1, Sección 3.2.1.1(a) (p. 125): a construction permit application is required for construction, reconstruction, remodelling, demolition, rehabilitation, expansion or alteration
prerequisites: Soil-conditions certification or study, as applicable (Sección 3.2.1.2(f))
Fondo del Seguro del Estado policy and municipal construction excise evidence once initially approved (Sección 3.2.1.2(g)–(h))
site_rules.sequence: Filed by a licensed architect or engineer; the permit closes with the Informe Final de Obras (Sección 3.2.1.1(f)).
evidence: Certified construction plans (site, architectural, structural)

site_rules.name: JP flood certification (certificación de inundabilidad)
site_rules.citation_section: Regla 3.2.1, Sección 3.2.1.2(c) (p. 125): a JP flood certification must be submitted for construction works
site_rules.sequence: Obtain before filing; it is a filing requirement of the construction permit.
evidence: Certificación de inundabilidad (JP)

site_rules.name: ICP archaeology and historic-conservation recommendation
site_rules.agency: Instituto de Cultura Puertorriqueña (ICP), requested through OGPe, the autonomous municipality or an Authorized Professional
site_rules.citation_section: Sección 2.1.8.7(b)(4) (p. 24): every public or private project involving earth movement, excavation or construction must request the ICP recommendation on archaeology and historic conservation
site_rules.sequence: Requested through the Unidad de Evaluación de Cumplimiento Ambiental before or with the construction permit.
evidence: ICP recommendation (arqueología y conservación histórica)

site_rules.name: Demolition of existing structures
site_rules.agency: OGPe or the autonomous municipality's permits office; DRNA (asbestos/lead, recycling plan); ICP in traditional urban centres
site_rules.citation_section: Regla 3.2.2(a)–(b) (pp. 126–127): demolition is filed through a construction permit; asbestos/lead-free certification; DRNA permits if present; DRNA recycling plan; written ICP recommendation in historic zones, traditional urban centres and archaeological sites
prerequisites: Asbestos- and lead-paint-free certification by a DRNA-certified inspector (Regla 3.2.2(b)(4))
DRNA permits before the construction permit if such materials exist (Regla 3.2.2(b)(5))
evidence: Asbestos / lead-paint certification
DRNA recycling plan

site_rules.name: Health recommendation for a public pool
site_rules.agency: Departamento de Salud, through OGPe or an autonomous municipality
site_rules.citation_section: Regla 4.3.11, Sección 4.3.11.1(a) (p. 238): to build, modify or remodel a public pool, plans are submitted for a Health recommendation before the construction permit
evidence: Pool plans per the ISPSC as adopted in the PR Building Code

site_rules.name: EPA NPDES Construction General Permit
site_rules.citation_section: 40 CFR 122.26(b)(14)(x) and (b)(15)(i): construction disturbing one acre or more (or part of a larger common plan) needs NPDES stormwater permit coverage
evidence: Notice of Intent (NOI) and Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP)

overlay_districts.name: Plan de Área del Centro Urbano Tradicional (PACUT) de Guaynabo
overlay_districts.meaning: The parcel lies inside the area of Guaynabo's Plan de Área for its Centro Urbano Tradicional (recorded on the JP calificación layer as overlay 'PA-PACUT'). RC 2023 lists 'PACUT — Distrito de Uso Mixto' among Guaynabo's POT districts (Tabla 6.6, p. 321).
overlay_districts.effect_basis: RC 2023 Sección 6.1.1.3(m) (p. 314): overlay areas or zones established by special plans or territorial plans prevail over the zoning districts under the equivalence. Sección 6.1.1.1(b), (d), (e) (p. 308): provisions of special plans not converted to RC districts prevail, and where provisions differ the one that best protects the resource prevails.
overlay_districts.provisions_needed: The PACUT plan's use and design provisions (uses, density, height, yards, design guidelines) and confirmation that they remain in force after the 2010 POT revision.
overlay_districts.obtain_from: Municipio Autónomo de Guaynabo — Oficina de Planificación y Ordenación Territorial (and the JP record of the plan's adoption)
